title: Build a Rocketlane alternative with Claude: free client onboarding tracker spec, 28/28 checks passed
description:
Claude built a Rocketlane alternative from one Markdown spec: all 28 acceptance checks passed in a real browser, along with 119 automated tests.
The test build also exposed 18 gaps in the spec, and every one is now fixed.

We gave Claude one Markdown spec for a client onboarding tracker for teams of 2 to 25 people and had it build the tool in four phases: people, templates and sign-in; projects, checklists and stage gates; notifications, the daily digest and projects on hold; and the client progress link, handoffs and CSV export. The core rule is the stage gate: a client project leaves Kickoff, Setup or Training only when every task in that stage is done or skipped with a reason, so Bluebird, with two Setup tasks still open, can't be handed off to Training. The gaps included Live projects that still counted as active, so their owners could never be deactivated, nothing stopping an admin deactivating the last admin, and digest items that named only the client once a client had two projects. What passed, what broke, what we didn't test, and when Rocketlane is still the better buy.
